start_here: Say to your AI: "Fill a canned reply template with the details of a request, such as a name or a button label, and give back the finished reply", with {"template":{"line":{"$kind":"binding","select":{"from":"dataSource","key":"caller_request","path":"greeting"}}},"caller_request":{"greeting":"Fresh bread at nine"}}. It runs tool:expand-a-reply-template and answers {"reply":{"line":"Fresh bread at nine"}}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Fill a canned reply template with the details of a request, such as a name or a button label, and give back the finished reply", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:expand-a-reply-template and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give a template (any JSON in which a value to fill is written as {"$kind":"binding","select":{"from":"dataSource","key":"caller_request","path":"label"},"default":...}) and the details to fill it from: caller_request, provider_record and data (each top-level entry of data can also be named as a key).
